Verify from the diff: (1) no path lets a gap without terminal punctuation become a sentence boundary; (2) transfer can never change, add or drop a word, and never puts a mark on a word the two decodes disagree on; (3) cached transcripts are re-punctuated or returned unchanged correctly; (4) no caller still passes the removed argument; (5) the must-fail tests (D3b's new reason, the rejected false ends, the reproduced fixture) are meaningful, not vacuous. Only state what you can verify; if uncertain, say so. (this chunk: pipeline/sentence_law.py)
